k80: Do not test unless ranks or crowding make it informative; frozen legacy XL gold rank 125 cannot be recovered by 80.
candidate_query_correction: Test exact acronym normalization of standalone RAG to retrieval augmented generation; retain all actions and other tokens; compare unchanged focused-v1. This is a technology alias, never keyed by case ID, candidate, project, gold, or source text.
budget_3_or_6: Only if five-group bounded selection loses material evidence; do not expand by default.
selection_rule: smaller internal K satisfying existing rank-five regression
scope: No training, datasets for training, model downloads, browser workflows, or deployment. Diagnostic fixtures are evaluation only.
missing_evidence: Cosine threshold is a plausibility heuristic, not entailment. Do not declare absence merely because a direct-action lexical match is missing. Preserve no-plausible-candidate status for below-threshold or empty pools.
decomposition: Retain structural-extractive-v1 unless retrieval experiments on the three under-split cases demonstrate a material loss requiring a safe correction.
